AUS.scope: Import, use and sale of products containing chrysotile, amosite and crocidolite banned in 2003 (others banned previously).

DNK.scope: Ban on all uses of asbestos except asbestos-cement roofing (1980); further asbestos-cement restrictions 1985-1988.

MUS.scope: Dangerous Chemicals Control Act 2004 declares all six asbestos types prohibited chemicals (import, manufacture, use or possession needs written authorisation).

LBN.scope: Import of crocidolite, amosite, anthophyllite, actinolite and tremolite banned; chrysotile imports not banned.

IRN.scope: Chrysotile use banned in 2021 as reported to the Rotterdam Convention in 2022; other forms banned previously.

GRC.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline of 1 January 2005.

LAO.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

NOR.scope: Ban (with exceptions) on all types of asbestos; revised 1991.

ISR.scope: Prevention of Asbestos Hazards Law (28 March 2011) regularised a de facto ban in place since the 1980s-90s (first ban on all fibre types 1984).

GBR.scope: Chrysotile banned (with minor exemptions) in 1999; crocidolite and amosite banned from 1 January 1986.

official.citation: Asbestos (Prohibitions) (Amendment) Regulations 1999 (SI 1999/2373), made 24 August 1999, in force 24 November 1999: import and use of chrysotile prohibited, with exemptions in the Schedule. Agrees with IBAS (1999).

CUB.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

IND.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

DZA.scope: All types of asbestos and products containing asbestos banned (Executive Decree 09-321).

LTU.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline (first restricting law 1998).

CHE.scope: Ban on crocidolite, amosite and chrysotile (some exceptions).

BRN.scope: Administrative rules on asbestos; IBAS lists Brunei among national bans but the chronology only says administrative rules were implemented (scope not stated).

SVN.scope: Production of asbestos-cement products banned (only chronology entry for Slovenia; scope of the current-list ban not given).

MCO.scope: Total ban on all forms of asbestos in July 2016 (use in building materials prohibited 1997).

PRT.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline of 1 January 2005.

CHL.scope: Asbestos banned by Decree No. 656 of the Ministry of Health.

AUT.scope: Ban on chrysotile with some exceptions.

IDN.scope: Government regulation 03/1985 banned crocidolite products only; chrysotile not banned.

SLV.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

GAB.scope: On IBAS current list; the chronology note adds that ILO information says asbestos has been banned in Gabon and the Seychelles. No year given.

KAZ.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

RUS.scope: Use of amphibole asbestos banned in 1999; chrysotile still used and mined.

CHN.scope: Ban on import and use of amphibole asbestos (2002); chrysotile not banned nationally; building-wall materials ban 2011; friction material ban 2003.

LIE.scope: Use, sale and export of six forms of asbestos including chrysotile banned; minor controlled exemptions allowed.

PHL.scope: Crocidolite, amosite, actinolite, anthophyllite and tremolite banned in July 2000; chrysotile regulated and still allowed.

NRU.scope: Import of all types of asbestos banned by order of 10 October 2024; all use prohibited by regulations of 30 October 2024.

FRA.scope: Ban (with exceptions) on chrysotile (IBAS chronology gives 1996; IBAS current-list note gives 1997 for the ban).

TJK.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

PAK.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

SVK.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline (2002 entry: expected to adopt EU restrictions banning all asbestos).

MOZ.scope: Comprehensive ban on production, use, import, export and trade approved 24 August 2010.

JPN.scope: Total ban on asbestos use in force 1 March 2012 (crocidolite and amosite banned 1995; chrysotile new use in building and friction materials from 2004; total ban announced 2005).

IRQ.scope: Decision No. 41 of 2016 adopting a national ban on asbestos (no import).

KWT.scope: All types of asbestos banned by Resolution No. 26 of 1995.

KGZ.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

EGY.scope: Ministerial prohibition of import and manufacture of all types of asbestos and asbestos materials.

MKD.scope: Total ban on all forms of asbestos.

SAU.scope: Asbestos banned under Council of Ministers Decision No. 162 of 1998; permanent enforcement committee approved February 2026.

FIN.scope: Ban (with exceptions) on chrysotile; in force 1993.

AZE.scope: Asbestos and asbestos-containing products added to the list of banned substances on 10 February 2026; prohibitions in force 1 July 2027.

OMN.scope: Listed by IBAS among national bans on all forms of asbestos (exemptions for minor uses are permitted in some listed countries). No year on the list page.

ECU.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

NCL.scope: Production, import and sale of asbestos banned.

EST.scope: All types of asbestos including chrysotile banned by Decree No. 72/2000 (2 November 2000); in force 1 July 2001; updated 28 February 2005.

LVA.scope: Asbestos banned (exemption for products already installed, which must be labelled).

ZAF.scope: Regulations of 28 March 2008 prohibit import, use, processing, manufacture or export of asbestos and asbestos-containing products (phase-out announced 2004).

MEX.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

NZL.scope: Import of asbestos-containing materials prohibited from 1 October 2016 unless a permit is granted; import of raw asbestos banned since 2002.

LUX.scope: Chrysotile, crocidolite and amosite banned (with Spain), following earlier EU directives.

HUN.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline (amphiboles banned 1988, asbestos-cement products 2003).

TKM.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

KOR.scope: Ban on use of all types of asbestos in 2009; total ban completed 1 April 2015 when the last derogations (submarine and missile gaskets and insulation) were removed.

SRB.scope: Listed by IBAS among national bans on all forms of asbestos (exemptions for minor uses are permitted in some listed countries). No year on the list page.

THA.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

BHR.scope: Ministerial Order banning import, manufacture and circulation of asbestos materials and products.

DEU.scope: Ban (with minor exemptions) on chrysotile; amosite and crocidolite banned earlier; chlor-alkali diaphragm derogation ended 2011.

BLR.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

MDA.scope: Listed by IBAS among national bans on all forms of asbestos (exemptions for minor uses are permitted in some listed countries). No year on the list page.

BOL.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

SWE.scope: Ban on use of all asbestos products (first bans 1982; crocidolite 1982).

JOR.scope: Immediate ban on amosite and crocidolite 16 August 2005; all forms banned for all uses after 16 August 2006.

CYP.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline (other forms banned previously).

DJI.scope: Listed by IBAS among national bans on all forms of asbestos (exemptions for minor uses are permitted in some listed countries). No year on the list page.

MLT.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline of 1 January 2005 (asbestos regulations in force 28 June 2002).

CAN.scope: Regulations banning manufacture, import, sale and use of asbestos and products containing asbestos, issued 1 October 2018; in force at the end of 2018.

HRV.scope: Asbestos added to list of prohibited substances in February 2005, implementation from 1 January 2006; IBAS notes the ban is reported as not enforced (export manufacture again permitted in 2006).

GRL.scope: Use of asbestos banned from 1 June 2010.

TUR.scope: Use of all types of asbestos banned from 31 December 2010 (regulation of 29 August 2010).

UKR.scope: Law of 6 September 2022 prohibits import, sale and use of all types of asbestos (2017 ban annulled in 2019; Ukraine removed from IBAS list 2017 and later restored).

SYC.scope: Imports of asbestos and asbestos articles banned (Statutory Instrument 51 of 2009); IBAS notes reported lack of enforcement in 2012.

BGR.scope: Import, production and use of all asbestos fibres and asbestos-containing products banned from 1 January 2005.

COL.scope: Law signed 11 July 2019 banning mining, commercialization, distribution and export of all types of asbestos including chrysotile.

ITA.scope: Ban on the use of all types of asbestos including chrysotile (some exceptions until 1994).

HND.scope: Ban on chrysotile, anthophyllite, actinolite, amosite and crocidolite products with exemptions for some insulation and fire-protection uses.

VNM.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

AGO.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

UZB.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

URY.scope: Listed by IBAS among national bans on all forms of asbestos (exemptions for minor uses are permitted in some listed countries). No year on the list page.

NPL.scope: Import, sale, distribution and use of all asbestos banned on 22 December 2014 with a sole exemption for automotive brake shoes and clutch plates; in force 20 June 2015. Not on the IBAS current list.

ROU.scope: Marketing and use of asbestos and asbestos-containing products banned from 1 January 2007 (chlor-alkali diaphragm derogation to 1 January 2008).

MYS.scope: Customs order bans import of all asbestos types except chrysotile (2012); crocidolite use banned in workplaces 1999.

ZWE.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

QAT.scope: Import of asbestos described as strictly prohibited.

CZE.scope: New use of chrysotile prohibited under the EU deadline of 1 January 2005 (import of asbestos banned 1998).

ARG.scope: Chrysotile production, import, marketing and use banned by resolution of 1 October 2001 (amphiboles banned 2000); gaskets and brakes ban in effect 2003; chlor-alkali diaphragm derogation ended 2014.

ISL.scope: Ban (with exceptions) on all types of asbestos; updated 1996.

BGD.scope: No national ban on record; asbestos still consumed (USGS, 2019–2023).

BRA.scope: Supreme Court ruled on 29 Nov 2017 that use of asbestos is unconstitutional; on 23 Feb 2023 the Court upheld the ruling, banning mining, processing and export. Earlier state-level bans from 2000/2001.

NLD.scope: First of a series of bans (with exceptions) on various uses of chrysotile.

USA.scope: Chrysotile asbestos phased out under the EPA rule of 2024; other forms and legacy uses not covered.

official.citation: Effective date of the EPA chrysotile final rule (Federal Register API record).

CIV.scope: Decree 96-682 (4 September 1996) banning import, manufacture and use of products containing asbestos.
